arxiv-1504-07946.title: Z ′ Z^{\prime} search in non-minimal Universal Extra Dimensions: two bumps and interference
arxiv-1504-07946.creator: AseshKrishna Datta † , Kenji Nishiwaki ‡ , Saurabh Niyogi ¶
arxiv-1504-07946.description: A 2015 arXiv research paper by AseshKrishna Datta † , Kenji Nishiwaki ‡ , Saurabh Niyogi ¶. We discuss prospects of the Z ′ Z^{\prime} search at the LHC in non-minimal Universal Extra Dimensions with tree-level brane-local terms in five dimensions. In this scenario, we find two major differences from the usual Z ′ Z^{\prime} physics: (i) two Z ′ Z^{\prime} candidates close-by in mass exist; (ii) the effective couplings to the SM fermions could be very large due to drastic overlapping of their profiles along the extra dimension.

arxiv-2311-15816.title: Scale-Dropout: Estimating Uncertainty in Deep Neural Networks Using Stochastic Scale
arxiv-2311-15816.creator: Soyed Tuhin Ahmed 9 2 , Kamal Danouchi 3 , Michael Hefenbrock 4 , Guillaume Prenat 3 , Lorena Anghel 3 , Mehdi B. Tahoori 2
arxiv-2311-15816.description: Abstract Uncertainty estimation in Neural Networks (NNs) is vital in improving reliability and confidence in predictions, particularly in safety-critical applications. Bayesian Neural Networks (BayNNs) with Dropout as an approximation offer a systematic approach to quantifying uncertainty, but they inherently suffer from high hardware overhead in terms of power, memory, and computation.

arxiv-2505-07014.title: When cardinals strategize: An agent-based model of influence and ideology for the papal conclave Journal: Elsevier
arxiv-2505-07014.creator: Nuno Crokidakis
arxiv-2505-07014.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nuno Crokidakis. We propose and analyze two agent-based models to investigate the dynamics of papal conclaves, focusing on how social influence, strategic voting, and ideological alignment affect the time required to elect a pope. In the first model, cardinals interact through two mechanisms: with probability p p , they imitate the choice of a randomly selected peer, and with probability q q , they shift support to the most voted candidate from the previous round.

arxiv-2508-20188.title: Grounding Multimodal Large Language Models with Quantitative Skin Attributes: A Retrieval Study
arxiv-2508-20188.creator: Max Torop Masih Eskandar Nicholas Kurtansky Jinyang Liu Jochen Weber, Octavia Camps Veronica Rotemberg Jennifer Dy Kivanc Kose
arxiv-2508-20188.description: Abstract Artificial Intelligence models have demonstrated significant success in diagnosing skin diseases, including cancer, showing the potential to assist clinicians in their analysis. However, the interpretability of model predictions must be significantly improved before they can be used in practice. To this end, we explore the combination of two promising approaches: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and quantitative attribute usage.

pmc-11516876.title: Vaccination campaign implementation in Madagascar: a Dynamic Sustainability Framework approach
pmc-11516876.creator: V Pavoncello, I Kislaya, D K Andrianarimanana, V Marchese, A O Tsiky Zafinimampera, O Totofotsy, Z A Randriamanantany, R A Rakotoarivelo, D I Puradiredja, D Fusco
pmc-11516876.description: BackgroundThe COVID-19 pandemic has highlighted the need for equitable and timely access to vaccination. Limited evidence is available on how to implement vaccination campaigns (VCs) that are sustainable and responsive to changes in real-world health policy and practice contexts. We present lessons learned from the implementation of a COVID-19 VC in the Boeny region of Madagascar.

pmc-12410724.title: Spatial heterogeneity of microbial community structure and its environmental drivers in surface sediments of Erhai Lake
pmc-12410724.creator: Hong Xiang, Cong-Gao Yang, Hao-Qin Xiong, Hao-Ran Bao, Jia-Zhuo Qu, Zhe-Xi Luan, Xiao-Long Sun, Li Zhen, Barathan Balaji Prasath, Barathan Balaji Prasath, Barathan Balaji Prasath
pmc-12410724.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). As a crucial plateau freshwater lake in Yunnan Province, China, Erhai Lake exhibits distinct environmental heterogeneity driven by its unique watershed characteristics and human activities, significantly influencing sediment microbial communities. This study investigated the spatial relationships between environmental factors and microbial community structures in surface sediments from the eastern, western, and northern shores using redundancy analysis (RDA) and Spearman correlation analysis.

pmc-12553670.title: From pixels to camera: scaling superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors for imaging at the quantum-limit
pmc-12553670.creator: Jun Gao, Jin Chang, Bruno Lopez-Rodriguez, Iman Esmaeil Zadeh, Val Zwiller, Ali W Elshaari
pmc-12553670.description: Superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors (SNSPDs) have emerged as essential devices that push the boundaries of photon detection with unprecedented sensitivity, ultrahigh timing precision, and broad spectral response. Recent advancements in materials engineering, superconducting electronics integration, and cryogenic system design are enabling the evolution of SNSPDs from single-pixel detectors toward scalable arrays and large-format single-photon time tagging cameras.

pmc-12585563.title: Cholera burden in Ghana: a systematic review and meta-analysis of prevalence, antimicrobial resistance and risk factors
pmc-12585563.creator: Frederick Kungu, Samuel Nee-Amugie Yartey, Anastasia A Asantewaa, Eric S Donkor
pmc-12585563.description: Cholera persists in Ghana due to sanitation challenges. This systematic review aims to synthesize data on the prevalence, antimicrobial resistance, risk factors and community knowledge of cholera in Ghana. Extensive literature searches were conducted in PubMed, Scopus, ScienceDirect, Web of Science and African Journal Online. After screening, we included 33 studies, assessing their quality using the Joanna Briggs Institute checklist.

pmc-12650919.title: Pilot Study: Algorithm-Based Assessment of Maxillary Sinus Volume in Zygomatic and Pterygoid Implant Planning
pmc-12650919.creator: Pablo García Roza, Iago Vila García, Miguel González Menéndez, Jesús Pato Mourelo, Jose Antonio Vega, M Zulima Fernández-Muñiz, James Kit-Hon Tsoi
pmc-12650919.description: Background/Objetives: Zygomatic implants are an effective solution for the prosthetic rehabilitation of atrophic maxillae, but their placement can alter maxillary sinus anatomy and influence surgical outcomes. This study presents a computational algorithm for automated segmentation and volumetric assessment of the maxillary sinus from cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) images, offering a reproducible and clinically oriented tool.

pmc-13563566.title: Reprogramming PD-L1 endosomal recycling and lysosomal degradation via engineered exosome-based nanocomposites overcomes immune resistance in lung cancer brain metastasis
pmc-13563566.creator: Xiujuan Hong, Xiaoqi Wang, Wankun Wang, Weiye Ren, Wenjia Ding, Dashan Yin, Chenli Wang, Chuan Sun, Jun Chen, Ji-Gang Piao, Zhibing Wu
pmc-13563566.description: While anti-PD-L1 antibody (αPD-L1) therapy holds promise, its efficacy against lung cancer brain metastasis (LCBM) is severely limited by the blood-brain barrier (BBB), the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment and adaptive immune resistance. To overcome these barriers, we engineered a pH-responsive nanocomposite (VP-αPD-L1@REB) by functionalizing brain-metastatic tumor cell-derived exosomes (EB) with RGD peptides (REB) for targeted co-delivery of verteporfin (VP) and αPD-L1.

pmc-13574917.title: Perceiving word structure in time: cross-linguistic evidence from English and Spanish
pmc-13574917.creator: Clara Cohen, Matthew T. Carlson, Paola E. Dussias
pmc-13574917.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Patterns of durational variation can offer rich phonetic cues to word structure, such as the number of syllables a word contains, or its morphological structure. In this study, we examine two types of durational cues: direct phonetic cues, which reflect phonological features, such as syllable count, and ancillary morphophonetic cues, which reflect phonological features triggered by morphological processes, such as suffixation.

pmc-13669987.title: Increased Pediatric Head and Neck Abscesses Following the COVID‐19 Pandemic
pmc-13669987.creator: Marco DiBlasi, Ryan C. Higgins, Nicole Welch, Dwight Jones, Arthur J. Chang
pmc-13669987.description: ObjectivesConcerns have emerged that COVID‐19‐related public health measures may have altered pediatric immune development and infection patterns, with studies suggesting an increase in pediatric abscesses following the pandemic. This study evaluated changes in the incidence, clinical features, and management of pediatric head and neck abscesses before, during, and after COVID‐19 lockdown restrictions.
